review.gallery: Three September 3, 2026 Dubai Land Department inspection photographs from Continental Club’s separate albums for Nautica One (2781, 976868015) and Nautica Two (2783, 977190637). The captions attribute the albums; the exterior frame does not establish a single tower. Seven design renders come from the Select Group brochure.
review.location: Developer map short link resolves to the development pin. The brochure separately indicates both towers. Travel groups were checked on page 3. The original map remains intact and the planned Creek Tower is omitted from the destination list.
review.floorPlans: Select Group consultant drawings on physical pages 15 and 17. Six one-bedroom and two two-bedroom examples per tower from Augusta’s public display, with Property Finder watermarks preserved. Area labels are rounded portal figures and are not presented as a verified built-up or internal measurement. The official project page gives decimal endpoints for the development.

unavailable: Verified tower-specific visitor entrances, exact areas for every unit and finished-home photography.
